_comment: Slash commands (§4.20). CONFIG, NOT CODE: an admin override in the agent_settings row `commands` (same shape, `commands` array; entries replace by `cmd`, `disabled: true` removes one) applies without a deploy.
A command is shown only to users who have EVERY tool in `requires` (the same per-user tool list the model is offered), so nobody sees a command their role cannot run.
`needs` are the argument slots in order: icao | flight | to | text | tier | operator | country. `optional` names one optional trailing slot.
`template`: {0} {1} … insert arguments; {1|default} inserts a default when the argument is empty; {1?text $} inserts `text` with $ replaced only when the argument is present.
`kind`: READ | CHANGES | ASKS FIRST | MAKES A FILE | SETTING. `/model` is a SETTING: it chooses the model tier for one message and sends nothing by itself.
